column1: # p300 — THE PAYLOAD CHANNEL p297 RECORDED AS ABSENT, MEASURED WITH BOTH CONTROLS.

# api.github.com, no raw path."  The first two clauses reproduce exactly.  The third
# is refuted: raw.githubusercontent.com answers 200 with the payload, and unlike the
# gateway probes of p294/p295 it DISCRIMINATES — a known-fake owner and a known-fake
# repo both 404 while the real path 200s.
